name: Lauren
title: Head of Geography at a large sixth-form college, Pearson author and Edexcel examiner
bio: Lauren has been Head of Geography at a large sixth-form college since 2007 and has a reputation for outstanding lessons.
She runs Geography Oxbridge workshops and has helped many students win places to read Geography at Oxford and Cambridge, including preparation for the new admissions tests.
Lauren is an author for Pearson Education, wrote chapters in two of the current A-level Geography textbooks, and has been an examiner for Edexcel.
offers: One-to-one online lessons for AS and A-level Geography (AQA and Edexcel)
Essay and extended-answer marking against the board's levels
Oxford and Cambridge Geography preparation, including the admissions tests and interviews

name: Glenda
title: Former Head of Geography at a large sixth-form college
bio: Glenda was Head of Geography at a large sixth-form college and has tutored A-level Geography for many years.
She is comfortable teaching every A-level Geography specification, AQA, Edexcel and the others, so she can work with whatever your school teaches.
offers: One-to-one online lessons for AS and A-level Geography on any specification
Exam technique for the 9-, 12-, 16- and 20-mark questions
Help with the NEA (independent investigation) within the board's rules
